    """Check a card number with the Luhn algorithm.

    Spaces are ignored. The function returns False when the remaining

    """
    if not isinstance(number, str):

    digits = number.replace(" ", "")

    if len(digits) < 2 or any(ch not in "0123456789" for ch in digits):

    total = 0
    for position, ch in enumerate(reversed(digits)):

        if position % 2 == 1:
